name: ariadne
description: Monorepo for Ariadne - Find call graphs in your codebase using tree-sitter

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ariadnejs/types build && pnpm --filter @ariadnejs/skill-protocol build && pnpm --filter @ariadnejs/skill-fs build && pnpm --filter @ariadnejs/core build && pnpm --filter @ariadnejs/mcp build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/skill-protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/skill-fs/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p .claude/skills/triage/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p .claude/skills/plan/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p .claude/hooks/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
